spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Little, small.
m. (-कः)
1 The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)
2 A drop of water.
n. adv. (-कं)
A little.
E.
ष्टुच to be clear or bright, घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)
E.
स्तोक a little, and कै to sound or cry, aff. क.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Diminutive, dwarfish.
E.
स्तोक, and काय body.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be praised, deserving or requiring praise.
E.
ष्टु to praise, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-ता-ची-तृ)
Praising, a praiser, a panegyrist.
E.
ष्टु to praise, aff. तृच्.

n. (-त्रं)
Praise, eulogium.
E.
ष्टु to praise, aff. ष्ट्रन्.

m. (-भः)
1 Stopping, obstructing.
2 Disrespect, contumely.
3 A division of the Sāma Veda.
E.
ष्टुभ to stop, aff. घञ्.

r. 10th cl. (स्तोमयति)
1 To praise, to eulogise.
2 To flatter, to wheedle, to coax.
3 To boast.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Crooked, bent.
m. (-मः)
1 A heap, a number, a multitude, a quantity.
2 Sacrifice, oblation.
3 Praise, eulogium.
n. (-मं)
1 The head.
2

Grain, corn.
4 A stick or staff bound with iron.
E.
ष्टु to praise, मन् Uṇādi aff.
